scenario: [LTAC.2.2.1] / [LRST.1.4]: the non-String half of `logical/LTAC.2.2.1_as_keyed_supersedure_string`. [LRST.1.4] makes `Int` a legal `as` key, and a key is compared by value. Three Req facts (distinct `entity_id`, so the logical upsert keeps all three) each arm a 100ms timer keyed on `r.n`, an Int: a (n 7) and b (n 7) at t=0, c (n 8) at t=50ms. b's arming supersedes a's (same key), so the key-7 timer fires once, at 100ms; c's key differs, so its timer survives and fires at 150ms. Pumping at 120ms and again at 200ms separates the two firings in time. Exact messages: armed x3, then `timer fired` twice. No supersedure gives three firings; keys compared as anything that collapses distinct Ints (every key read as "") lets c supersede the key-7 timer and gives one. log_message_sequence is exact list equality, for the reason the String vector gives.
rules_ds:
schema Req scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    n: Int mutable

rule arm:
    Req r
->
    log info "armed"
    after 100ms as r.n:
        log info "timer fired"
